scope.notional_cap_caveat: safe-3's ORIGINAL reason for the 'bold' OTM choice (accounts.json grid.sizing_profiles.safe: "OTM strikes... to fit the $600 notional cap at $2K -- ATM doesn't place this small") is a real, disclosed, UNRESOLVED tension with this fix: at ATM pricing, a higher per-contract premium may itself collide with the SAME $600 (Safe 30%-of-$2K) per-trade cap from the opposite direction (RISK_CAP instead of SKIP_MIN_PREMIUM_FLOOR).
